simple.meaning: שֵׁלָנִי (Shêlânîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֵׁלָנִי (H8024) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שֵׁלָנִי (H8024) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שֵׁלָנִי (Shêlânîy) / H8024 is traced through Numbers 26:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah
definitions.full: H8024. Shelani שֵׁלָנִי adjective, of a people of foregoing: with article as collective noun ׳הַשּׁ Num 26:20 (P). So read also 1Chr 9:5 ; Neh 11:5 , see שִׁילֹנִי .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
